summary: Observed on the live plane for the observer's own session (adv 29827): (1) the launch desired->prepared->applied receipt chain (13137-13139); (2) control and restart transitions (13140-13145, 13210-13212); (3) a lost acknowledgement (generation 4 absent) resynced via full-resync and converged to applied; (4) stable actor, principal and session across every event; (5) 317 real tool rows joined to the open layer span for event 13212, plus 5 inference rows attributed to events 13145, 13191 and 13212; (6) a live fleet leader's applied fleet-posture:su.fleet-leader attachment (13163, 13170, 13177). SELECT count(*) FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations t JOIN harness_shared.session_identity_layer_spans s ON s.workspace_id=t.workspace_id AND s.owner_id=t.coord_owner_id AND t.invoked_at>=s.active_from AND (s.active_until IS NULL OR t.invoked_at<s.active_until) WHERE t.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND t.coord_owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd' AND t.invoked_at > '2026-09-22 18:35:00+00' AND s.activation_event_id=13212

SELECT count(*), jsonb_agg(DISTINCT u.identity_activation_event_id), jsonb_agg(DISTINCT u.identity_stack_refs) FROM harness_shared.agent_usage_samples_identity_attribution u WHERE u.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND u.ts > 1790100000000 AND u.identity_owner_id='su-38e71009-f36b-4ca7-8a14-e617921fd7cd'

SELECT e.id, e.owner_id, e.phase, e.source, e.stack_refs, e.recorded_at FROM harness_shared.session_identity_activation_events e WHERE e.workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND e.stack_refs::text LIKE '%fleet-leader%' AND e.phase='applied' ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 3

assertions.evidence: The launch chain for adv_session 29827 is 13137 desired/source=launch, then 13138 prepared, then 13139 applied (gen 1, spec ad97ad3c2714, state 37b21f82cba4). The mode:set auto control transition is 13140 desired, then 13144 prepared, then 13145 applied (gen 2, stack [autonomy:su.mode-auto], state 6d031da47dd3). The carry-respawn re-render is 13210 desired/source=restart, then 13211 prepared, then 13212 applied (gen 5, spec 5749872a5ad7, state 18cf633bd759). Every applied row is preceded by its own prepared row for the same revision pair.

No generation-4 row exists for this owner. The successor turn at 18:35Z received a CTRL full-resync with reason generation-mismatch (previousGeneration 3, generation 5) and activation status 'desired' with applied lagging (desired 5749872a/18cf633b vs applied ad97ad3c/6d031da4). After coord:orient { afterCompaction:true } the persisted control_state read status 'applied' at generation 6, and events 13211/13212 record the prepared/applied phases for the desired pair. A lost acknowledgement was retried and converged, never merged behind.

All 11 activation events for this owner carry actor_id == owner_id, principal_id 'system:superuser' and adv_session_id 29827, across the launch, control and restart sources and across a carry-respawn.

session_identity_layer_spans holds three contiguous autonomy-slot spans for this owner: events 13145 (18:07:48 to 18:23:30Z), 13191 (18:23:30 to 18:35:06Z) and 13212 (from 18:35:06Z, open). Each span's active_until equals the next span's active_from. 317 real tool_invocations rows since 18:35Z join the open span for event 13212 (sample ids 28814534, 28814509, 28814495; tools include capability:bash, code:run, coord:declare-intent). 5 inference rows in agent_usage_samples_identity_attribution (sample ids 128042, 128041, 128019) attribute to activation events 13145, 13191 and 13212 with identity_stack_refs [autonomy:su.mode-auto], across both specification revisions.

A live fleet leader, owner su-c03852cb, has applied control events 13163 (18:16:13Z), 13170 (18:17:40Z) and 13177 (18:18:38Z), each with stack_refs [autonomy:su.mode-auto, fleet-posture:su.fleet-leader]. The leader posture layer attached through the same desired/prepared/applied control path.
